scope: Execution of the native CPU/GPU implementation and measurement plan; not certification of acceleration or generic-RC support

requirements.requirement: Integrate into isolated original VPR CPU routing framework, retaining original STA, criticality, lookahead, route-tree updates and congestion negotiation.
Measure CPU/GPU connection search on identical graph, occupancy/history, seeds, timing and objective snapshots, including preparation/synchronization/return cost; validate results.
Selective offload using measured work/parallelism thresholds; preserve sequential commit in first comparison; retain CPU fallback.
requirements.result: Experimental budget and CPU fallback implemented/calibrated. No profitable default region established; production default stays CPU.

requirements.requirement: Resident GPU graph/state and sparse coherent updates; CPU and GPU use matching native timing and congestion semantics.
Batch independent connections from different nets and overlap independent CPU work; validate resource independence, conflict retry and dependent same-tree ordering.
requirements.result: Actual independent-net batching and CPU/GPU overlap validated. Resource conflicts wait before state reads; expanded old-tree domains protected. Guarded CPU comparison remains infeasible on elliptic.

requirements.requirement: Reuse native in-process RRG, route trees and STA to remove redundant intermediate export/reload, retaining final legality/timing validation.

Same-worker original VPR, CPU control, selective and batched hybrid comparisons on six frozen real circuits; full workflow and search timing, legality, CPD, wire, movement and dispatch metrics; repeat positive findings and report 5% quality budget failures.
requirements.result: Six-case same-worker matrix complete, including failures. Cooperative elliptic follow-ups and three local CPU repeats complete. No positive GPU candidate requires confirmation.

requirements.requirement: Record source/input bindings, commands, platform terminal status and independent verification; document measured dispatch policy and all limitations without extrapolating unmeasured acceleration.
requirements.result: 25 submitted jobs terminal; frozen 18 bundles/5 CUDA builds/26 inputs audited; all failures retained; final timing parser and attribution tests pass.

limitations: No native hybrid GPU end-to-end acceleration demonstrated; 2048-pop offload is experimental, not a proven profitable default.
GPU implementation supports validated zero-RC/nonflat MapLookahead/SM90 only; batch additionally requires fanout-invariant base costs and no nonconfigurable cross-region groups.
Primary one-CTA elliptic timed out and old batch ownership checks failed. Later cooperative versions route legally but remain slower than serial VPR.
Latest matched guarded CPU control is infeasible after 200 iterations; no speedup ratio is calculated against it.
Original parallel and modified CPU controls are unstable in local repeats (signals/timeouts); root causes are unresolved. Local measurements are not mixed with H100 timing.
Successful cooperative elliptic follow-ups use different configurations from the primary six-case matrix; no claim that one configuration completed all six with acceleration.
State bytes exclude static graph upload and logical query payload. Parallel search timers sum worker elapsed time, not critical-path wall time.
